title: What to do immediately after a minor car accident
desc: Essential safety, legal, and insurance steps to take at the scene of a crash.
todos: Check all passengers for injuries and move vehicles to a safe area out of traffic if possible.
Call 911 or local police to file an official accident report, even for minor damage.
Exchange names, phone numbers, drivers license details, and insurance policy info with all drivers involved.
Take detailed photos and video of scene damage, road conditions, skid marks, and vehicle positioning.
Notify your auto insurance provider as soon as possible to initiate the claims process.
